_about: Lead time between when an agenda appeared on the town's agenda platform and the meeting date, for meetings already held. CivicPlus AgendaCenter shows 'Posted <timestamp>' (or 'Amended <timestamp>' after an edit, which replaces the original time, so amended rows understate lead time); CivicClerk's public API gives publishOn per agenda file and the meeting start time.

method.lead_days: meeting date minus the calendar date the agenda was posted
method.lead_hours_to_day_start: hours from posting to 00:00 on the meeting day (a lower bound: most meetings start in the evening, adding ~17-19 h)
method.lead_hours_to_start: CivicClerk only: hours from publishOn to the scheduled start time
method.first_posting_only: CivicPlus rows marked 'Posted' (not 'Amended') plus all CivicClerk rows
method.all_rows: also CivicPlus 'Amended' rows and Revize upload stamps (?t=YYYYMMDDhhmmss on each document link), both of which can postdate the first posting

excluded.why: Legistar's API gives only the last (re)publish time, normally after the meeting
